oftlaunch3: This is a first for our branch. O F T kits are now in the Log Book, and every single kit gets its own tracking number, from the moment it's logged, all the way to the collation branch.
Before, every kit was typed by hand. Sheet after sheet, the same number again and again. Now, the system does it for us.
Here's how it works. Collect the sample from your client, open the Log Book, and choose O F T Kit.
Our branch system looks up your client and fills in the policy number for you. Less typing, and more time for busy agents on the go.
Press log, and your tracking number appears, instantly. Write it on the kit, before you hand it in.
Hand the kit to sales support. They sign for it on their phone, and you get an e-mail the moment they do.
Then the system builds the transmittal for them, with this quarter's collation branch and every kit on one page. All they do is print.
Need to find a kit? Search the number, the policy, or your client's name, and see exactly where it is.
A first for our branch. From today, every O F T kit goes through the Log Book. Ricky Rampersad branch dot com, slash log book.
